      </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="190" fill="url(#circleGradient)"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
Changes made:
- Gave the page a real title instead of the hash-like string
- Made the SVG responsively scale (`width/height: 100%` with `max-width/height`) instead of a fixed 400px box
- Added a light background so the circle isn't just black-on-white
- Replaced the flat black fill with a subtle radial gradient for depth
- Slightly inset the circle radius (190 vs 200) so it doesn't get clipped, and added `role="img"`/`aria-label` for accessibility

Let me know if you had a different look or purpose in mind (e.g. a logo, icon, specific brand colors) and I can adjust further.
